title: Nutrition — where the food box lives
question: The box that already takes a food name or a whole sentence (with camera and barcode) used to hide behind the +. Two places to put it on the screen. Pick one.

options.label: Under the tubes
options.thesis: The box right under the four tubes: you see the day, then you add to it.
options.viewport: Tubes, the box, what is left, water, meals.
options.risk: The meals list starts lower; two rows show above the tab bar.

options.label: Inside Meals
options.thesis: The box at the top of the Meals card: what you add appears right under it.
options.viewport: Everything as before; the box heads the meals.
options.risk: It sits lower on the screen, further from the thumb's first reach on open.
